summary_en: 750,000 shares (3.31% of 22,675,222 ex-treasury), ¥400M ceiling. Execution window Sep 1, 2026 – May 31, 2027. Method: ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases. Rationale: flexible capital allocation.
